environment.configuration: 2D Release, normal -O2, KIN_DEV_FAST_SCRIPTING OFF, PCH ON, compiler cache OFF, LTO OFF, mold
environment.host_activity: Unrelated work remained active on the host; sample load averages are retained.

implementation.value_types: DistanceFieldStyle, RendererBackendCapabilities, GpuScopeTiming, ComputeBindings and RendererBackendStats moved byte-for-byte from backend.hpp to backend_types.hpp. Backend still includes and exports them.
implementation.renderer_header: Includes backend_types and its public value dependencies directly; forward-declares Window, IRenderer2DBackend, IRendererBackend3D, JobSystem and CompressedImage.
implementation.forwarders: renderer_3d, set_overdraw_view, pipeline_record and prewarm_pipelines definitions moved into renderer2d.cpp, preserving signatures, qualifiers and bodies.
implementation.additional_repairs: renderer2d_shapes.cpp accesses the private backend and needs its direct interface include; further findings are recorded below.
implementation.compatibility: Consumers constructing/calling Window need platform/window.hpp. Custom backend implementations and callers owning make_render_backend return values need renderer/backend.hpp. Shared rendering data remains available through renderer2d.hpp.
implementation.runtime_tradeoff: Four forwarding methods become out-of-line. Without LTO, callers lose their previous opportunity to inline those methods. No runtime-performance speedup or zero-overhead claim is made.
implementation.contracts: 13 separate renderer header translation units, including renderer2d and backend_types, with PCH and unity disabled.

plan_method.method: Temporarily append a comment; run Ninja -n against a copy of the generated manifest in the configured build directory to avoid dry-run CMake glob regeneration; restore bytes and nanosecond timestamps. Each phase starts with a clean plan.
plan_method.real_build_cross_check: All four completed Clang backend/Window edits produced exactly their planned object sets.
plan_method.concurrency_limitation: The after-phase dependency dry runs rewrote headers while no-PCH compiler checks were still running. That input-file race is a plausible explanation for the Clang crash, but the cause was not proven. Both isolated retries passed after the probes ended. Subsequent header probes are serialized after all compiler checks and reject active worktree compilers.

timing_method.scope: Each backend.hpp/window.hpp edit through hex_demo link, affected sources/game PCH/archives/link included; unrelated objects/dependencies/shaders prebuilt.
timing_method.compiler_scope: Clang wall-time samples only in this round; dependency and functional validation use both Clang and GCC.
timing_method.command: GNU time around taskset -c 0,2,4,6 cmake --build BUILD --parallel 4 --target hex_demo
timing_method.order: Before backend/Window, after backend/Window; one completed sample per header/version, separate phases rather than interleaved.
timing_method.interpretation: Exploratory single observations under varying external load. Counts are the primary result; no controlled percentage wall-speedup or full-build improvement is claimed.
timing_method.restoration: Restore headers after each edit; rebuild game PCHs against restored inputs and repeat smoke/API/no-change checks.
timing_method.memory: RSS is maximum child process, not concurrent aggregate.

layout_validation.scope: sizeof/alignof of 21 types including Renderer2D, Window and all five moved value types; Flip numeric values; Clang/GCC, render-probe on/off.

syntax_selection.method: Transitive repository include consumers of renderer2d.hpp or backend_types.hpp

limits: Header-edit counts are specific to these configurations/targets, not percentages for clean builds or game-source edits.
One timing observation per header/version with background activity is not a controlled speedup ratio.
Four forwarding methods move out of the header; runtime performance at this call boundary was not benchmarked in this round.
Optional 3D checks are syntax/template compilation only. No Windows/MSVC or full 3D/GPU runtime validation.

steps: Prepare persistent Clang/GCC builds and prebuild the three targets at base_commit using the recorded configuration; adjust paths and TMPDIR.
Run interface_fanout.py before, interface_layout.py before, interface_measure.py before backend and interface_measure.py before window.

Apply the change; run interface_validate.py, interface_syntax.py clang gcc clang-3d and interface_layout.py after. Repair direct includes and recheck failed sources using KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY if needed.

Save the changed headers to expected-backend.hpp, expected-renderer2d.hpp and expected-window.hpp before timing. After validation compilations finish, run interface_fanout.py after, interface_measure.py after backend and interface_measure.py after window.
Run interface_restore.py and interface_mechanical.py, then interface_record.py.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,re,shlex,subprocess,sys,time
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/bamedeo/kin-wt/build-time');base=pathlib.Path('/mnt/windows/Users/amedeo/Desktop/gamedev');out=base/'kin-renderer-interface-bench';env={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(base/'kin-renderer-interface-tmp')};selected=sys.argv[1:] or ['clang','gcc','clang-3d'];tasks=[]
# Follow repository includes backwards from the renderer/backend type headers to audit
# every known consumer, including tests and optional 3D, without PCH.
parents={}
for folder in ['engine','tests','games']:
 for path in (repo/folder).rglob('*'):
  if path.suffix not in ['.cpp','.hpp','.h','.inl']:continue
  for name in re.findall(r'^\s*#\s*include\s*[<"]([^>"]+)[>"]',path.read_text(errors='replace'),re.M):
   for candidate in [path.parent/name,repo/'engine/include'/name]:
    if candidate.is_file():
     parents.setdefault(candidate.resolve(),set()).add(path.resolve());break
pending=[repo/'engine/include/kin/renderer/renderer2d.hpp',repo/'engine/include/kin/renderer/backend_types.hpp'];affected=set()
while pending:
 path=pending.pop().resolve()
 if path in affected:continue
 affected.add(path);pending.extend(parents.get(path,[]))
(out/'syntax-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method':'Transitive repository include consumers of renderer2d.hpp or backend_types.hpp','sources':sorted(str(p.relative_to(repo)) for p in affected if p.suffix=='.cpp')},indent=2)+'\n')
for mode in selected:
 build=base/{'clang':'kin-build-time-clang','gcc':'kin-build-time-out','clang-3d':'kin-build-time-3d-clang'}[mode]
 for entry in json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text()):
  source=pathlib.Path(entry['file'])
  if source.suffix!='.cpp' or not source.resolve().is_relative_to(repo) or source.resolve() not in affected:continue
  only=set(filter(None,os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY','').split(',')))
  if only and str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo)) not in only:continue
  args=shlex.split(entry['command']);cmd=[];i=0
  while i<len(args):
   if args[i:i+2] in [['-Xclang','-include-pch'],['-Xclang','-include']] and i+3<len(args) and args[i+2]=='-Xclang' and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+3]:i+=4;continue
   if args[i] in ['-include','-include-pch'] and i+1<len(args) and 'cmake_pch.' in args[i+1]:i+=2;continue
   if args[i]=='-o':i+=2;continue
   if args[i] in ['-c','-fpch-preprocess','-Winvalid-pch','-fpch-instantiate-templates']:i+=1;continue
   cmd.append(args[i]);i+=1
  cmd.append('-fsyntax-only');relative=str(source.resolve().relative_to(repo));tasks.append((mode,build,relative,cmd))
# Report production errors before tests to speed up dependency repairs.
tasks.sort(key=lambda t:('/tests/' in '/'+t[2],not any(x in t[2] for x in ['/renderer/','/particles/','/tilemap/','/ecs/']),t[0],t[2]))
def check(task):
 mode,build,relative,cmd=task;log=out/('syntax-'+mode+'-'+relative.replace('/','_')+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=build,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'configuration':mode,'source':relative,'exit_code':r.returncode,'wall_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pch':False}
 if r.returncode:print('FAIL '+mode+' '+relative+'\n'+log.read_text()[:5000],flush=True)
 return row
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(check,t) for t in tasks]):
  rows.append(future.result());(out/('syntax-results-'+'-'.join(selected)+('-targeted' if os.environ.get('KIN_HEADER_SYNTAX_ONLY') else '')+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'checked':len(rows),'failures':sum(r['exit_code']!=0 for r in rows)}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(r['exit_code'] for r in rows))
